title: Rick Brown
text:
I am currently an Assistant Professor Mathematics and the director of the data science program at Southern Utah University where I teach primarily statistics and data science courses.
I received a Bachelor’s of Science in Mathematics with an option in Statistics from California State University, Chico, a Master’s of Science in Statistics from Colorado State University and a PhD in Applied Mathematics from the University of Montana. I worked as a Mathematical Statistician for the United States Census Bureau between obtaining my master’s and going back to graduate school for my PhD.
